ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio (approx. 0.15); the surface consists primarily of low-intensity dark pixels with high-intensity white patches concentrated at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-contrast white patch on the distal-right lobe tip; series of vertical white linear streaks on the distal-left lobe; scattered white circular ring clusters in the mid-ventral region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory following an upward and outward sweep from the central region toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 4-6 unaligned vertical white linear pixel disruptions concentrated on the distal portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, irregular tan and white pixel clusters representing barnacle colonization attached to the distal-most tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
